summary: The two Urgent rules cover most red-box criteria, but the admission box is given Urgent priority the page does not justify, 'Difficulty walking' over-broadens 'unable to walk unaided', and haemoptysis ignores the 1 tablespoon threshold. Hb < 8, infection control, social circumstances and inpatient judgement are not encoded (not representable).
